description: Tenant themes must declare these tokens explicitly in :root and .dark. The bundle supplies :where() defaults, but some alias to a different semantic role than Registry / product intent — relying on the default silently mis-maps flyouts and cards.

notes.--popover: Bundle default is var(--surface-raised). Registry flyouts use page paper (light) / card surface (dark), not raised cream.
notes.--popover-foreground: Bundle default is var(--foreground). Declare alongside --popover so dark-mode pairs stay explicit.
